info.title: MODO Sales Executive Mobile API
info.description: Test the ERP mobile APIs here. First grant the user Mobile App Access in Membership > Users. Login using email/password, or send WhatsApp OTP then verify it. Copy data.token into Authorize (without Bearer), and supply X-Plant-Id for workspace requests. The OTP template is sales_executive_login with one six-digit parameter. Codes expire in five minutes. Swagger does not send requests until you click Execute. Existing module permissions and plant ownership still apply.

post.description: An administrator must grant mobile app access for this email in Membership > Users first. Email/password login returns the bearer token directly. Alternative: Send WhatsApp OTP and Verify OTP.

200.description: Success. Decimal fields can serialize as strings. Lists use Laravel pagination under data. Schedule creation/update reuse the existing schedule response field.

post.description: Passwordless alternative. Mobile app access must be granted by an administrator first. Set mobile to a uniquely registered user number. Returns 202 after WhatsApp provider submission. Enter the received code in otp and run Verify OTP.

202.description: WhatsApp submission accepted; no token until verification.
